model_output.verdict: Your product design work at Loop Fitness shows what you made, but I’d hesitate to move this resume forward without knowing more about the problems you worked on. What design work, if any, have you done since leaving Loop?
write_up: You designed apps at Loop Fitness and client work at Brightpath Studio, and you’re now working at Ferry Street Coffee. It’s common for a design resume to list what was made without saying what it was meant to solve or what the team learned. For product design roles, that makes it tough to stand out in a pile.

The line about creating Loop’s first design system is your best model: it names the deliverable, the tool and your part in making it. Your current job accounts for the time since Loop, though a recruiter will still look for recent design work.
Let’s start with the Loop role. Add what you contributed to the weekly releases and what you tested with members. If you have more recent design work, bring that into the resume too.
